subject: question on how to do regression scores for shape and size

messages.author: 954265ab4506b84c
messages.subject: question on how to do regression scores for shape and size
parts:
Dear all,

I am a frequent user of geomorph package and when exploring allometry, I usually visualize how shape and size are correlated with the RegScore or CAC plot obtained from procD.allometry. Of course, I also perform procD.lm or procD.pgls to test the significance of the relationship or to obtain the residuals. However, as this function as been reomved in the new version of geomorph, I wonder if it is possible to visualize this kind of plot in an relatively easy way or if there is some reason why they are not longer recommended.

Thank you very much in advance,

Best,

Alberto Martin-Serra

Alberto,

Rather than respond with the solution, I request that you consult the several vignettes available that will help you find the solution. We made sure in these to point users who were used to previous functions to the updated functions that achieve the same results. I prefer to push users to use these resources, as they are really helpful. 
  
Cheers!
Mike
